kind: Blender Cycles product illustration using licensed CAD keycaps

sequence.sampling: Original .005 samples plus .001 samples across the first keycap lift (.29-.38). All frames rendered in Blender Cycles.

colour: AgX SDR WebP output; no HDR-display claim
description: A brandless ANSI keyboard with licensed keycap profiles, ribs and stem sockets. Independently authored hollow switch and stabilizers, case and studio rig. The metal Enter, upper housing, amber stem, constant-thickness spring and lower housing separate in stages along one axis, then assemble and press. A camera arc reveals the layers. Actual Typing Agent gameplay follows the illustrative input study.

keycaps.author: Santiago Castelo
keycaps.material: Illustrative satin titanium Enter among charcoal PBT caps

mechanismValidation.scope: Evaluated bevelled/curved focal mechanism mesh surface intersections in mm, plus analytic adjacent-coil clearance and projected cap framing; no bounding-box-only collision verdict. This is a geometry check, not a physical simulation or manufacturing certification.
